name: govocal-prototypes
description: Monorepo of design prototypes, built to a static site for private sharing.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-index.mjs && node build.js && npx --yes serve dist
scripts.deploy: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && node scripts/build-index.mjs && node build.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name govocal-prototypes --branch main
